- Provides 6 'void' variants inspired by the vanilla void chicken
- Provides 24 colors of optional saddles, saddle pads, and bridles
- Optional overlay for rainbow/prismatic hair that can be added over any horse skin
- Optional horse flute item recolor to match your horse
- All skins have a corresponding head icon for the menu

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-671416052.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "How to Install:"]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to choose the name of the "Horse Skin," "Saddle Color," "Saddle Pad Color," or "Bridle Color" you want. All options except for "Horse Skin" can be left blank or set to "false" to disable. Saddle pads will only apply if you have a saddle enabled. If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead.
[b][color=#e69138]6[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new horse!

If you want to use different horse skins in co-op, you will need another mod such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7681]Multiplayer Horse Reskin[/url]. The horse images from this mod will have to be copied into that mod's asset folder.
